capabilities: Add technology nodes via a customizable two-ring quick wheel
Create SVG cards from reusable templates with fields and icons
Link cards to Markdown notes or heading sections
Navigate large canvases with search, minimap, and previous view
Import and export templates, module presets, and wheel configuration
extras: No account, analytics, or telemetry; data stays in the local vault. Mobile is not supported; macOS and Linux untested. Interface language can follow Obsidian or be set to Chinese or English.
intentEvidence: Tech Tree Companion extends Excalidraw in Obsidian with a customizable quick wheel, reusable SVG cards, and linked note details.
problem: Excalidraw is freeform, so assembling a structured technology tree of templated cards, prerequisite links, and note-backed details is entirely manual.

relations.evidence: Tech Tree Companion extends Excalidraw in Obsidian with a customizable quick wheel

summary: Excalidraw companion for building technology trees with a customizable quick wheel, reusable SVG cards, and linked note details.
